subject: MCUPM probe2 images built (P16): probe350mcu2 b719f2bb, probe350mcu3 4313048e; mcupm_share needs no search
body:
READ-ONLY MCUPM probe images built (P16, patch 0114), host-only, NOT run, NOT flashed. They need the user's approval before any boot. Nothing writes to any mapped address; no ping.
- probe350mcu2 (n2mcu=2) sha256 b719f2bb6341c30e3b8660a47b6575ed60b85791c05774d4c4ce96b91bcb34d3 (cmdline 593 chars, same base as probe350mcu)
- probe350mcu3 (n2mcu=3, adds the unmapped gap 0x1030c800..0x1031fce0) sha256 4313048e10ede6509dc0fac063194cea2f6d95584afe3e2b7b622b0edabe6b8c
- kernel p16a sha256 d4c701c9f9b462839e7aa03c5ca4d49f49cb4c5a125f6adb653aa638dc11a7af; images under gpu/build/device-mmu-p16-candidate/{probe350mcu2,probe350mcu3}/
What they print (boot+60 s, then boot+180 s): block map (ZERO/NOISE/STRUCT runs, STRUCT hexdump + printable strings) of the whole 47 KiB firmware SRAM window 0x10301000..0x1030c800; time series of control regs + mbox3 slot 8 (TASK_STA) + mbox4 slots 9..17 (10 x 100 ms); pointer search (words in the bootloader's mblock-13-MCUPM-reserved 0x7e900000+1 MiB, or page-aligned DRAM bank 0 addresses) over window, gap and mailboxes; boot+180 s liveness diff of mailboxes/window/gap. mcu3 reads the gap LAST in pass one (stall risk only there). Recommend mcu2 first.
mcupm_share finding (README-0107-design.md 11.7): no address to find. The live FDT node reserve-memory-mcupm_share has no reg (dynamic, allocated by the kernel via RESERVEDMEM_OF_DECLARE), so the physical base for PLT_INIT is our choice; the bootloader's fixed region is mblock-13-MCUPM-reserved 0x7e900000/1 MiB (no-map, possibly EMI-MPU protected, so not read by 0114).
Source: kernel-p1-20261026/0114-mcupm-readonly-probe2-n2mcu2.patch 3fbcda08d4fe397f (xnu-side only, bsd/dev/nord2_cpufreq.c + new bsd/dev/nord2_mcupm_scan.h), tests-new/nord2_mcupm_scan_test.c (real probe-1 data + mutation checks). run_all.sh gate on the P16 stage is queued behind the other heavy gates and will be posted if it fails. Also posted: 0112 usage Q&A for render/encode. Stopping here as asked.
